checklist_items.2.1: Every text control is checked for its accessible label, control type, empty default and help text, and the inventory also records that the name has no placeholder and no maximum length attribute so the field is not relying on one. The values that are not edited are captured from the POST body itself rather than assumed: the create asserts the whole payload equals name/type/all_nodes/targets/path, so the untouched type and scope fields are shown to submit their displayed defaults.
checklist_items.2.6: The name input is driven three ways and each one is read back from the control: per-key typing followed by Backspace (the value shortens by exactly the deleted characters and completes correctly), a real clipboard paste, and select-all plus Delete which leaves the field empty. A paste that the controlled value drops is a real defect and is caught.
checklist_items.2.5: A real name collision is built against the live list: the case reads the existing storage names from GET /api/v1/storages, opens the add dialog and submits that exact name, because store's lookup is an exact match. The server answers 409 with code STORAGE_NAME_TAKEN, the dialog stays open and keeps the typed name so the operator can correct it, and no duplicate record is created. Renaming to a free name then creates successfully, which shows the refusal was about the collision and not an unsavable form; that record is deleted again so the case leaves nothing behind. A mutant that returns the wrong product code is caught on the code assertion.
checklist_items.2.2: The name is validated after trimming: '  spaced  ' is accepted and stored as 'spaced', while a run of only spaces trims to empty and is refused. Nothing is submitted by the rejected attempt.
checklist_items.2.3: The name's length contract is 1 to 63 characters, taken from storageForm.ts's /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/. A single character is accepted, 63 characters are accepted and 64 are refused - each driven through the real field and read from the form item's own error state rather than from a click.
checklist_items.2.4: The allowed alphabet is lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens. 'ok-name-2' is accepted, while an uppercase value, a non-latin value, an underscore and an inner space are each refused by the field. The refusal is the form item going to its error state, not merely the browser rejecting a keystroke.
checklist_items.1.1: On first open the add dialog shows four type radios. Local storage is selected. NFS, NFS with local cache, and the mounted shared directory are visible and not selected. The local type description is visible. Name and Directory are empty textboxes. Neither has a unit or a maximum length. The name help states the 1-to-63 lowercase, digit, or hyphen range. The directory help is visible. Export, mount options, and the cache directory are absent. Applies to has All nodes selected. By label and One by one are visible and not selected. Mixed is absent. There is no spinbutton. Reading the dialog sends no storage POST. A relative directory shows the absolute-path error and sends no create. The minimum create sends POST /api/v1/storages with name, type local, all_nodes true, an empty targets list, and the directory path. The list row, the detail page, and the independent GET keep that name, type local, path, and all_nodes true.
checklist_items.1.2: On first open the add dialog shows an empty name, an empty directory, local storage selected, and all nodes selected, and those fields are present immediately with no loading gate before Save. An empty name is rejected on the name field and sends no storage create. The add dialog and the edit dialog have no password field. After the local create, the detail overview configuration card is one small card. Opening edit backfills that name, that directory, and the all-nodes scope, and the edit dialog shows the local type.
checklist_items.1.11: covered: Cancel, close and Escape each close the add dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no storage write, so the stored storages stay unchanged
checklist_items.1.3: Name and path are the required fields on a local storage. Submitting an empty name and submitting a whitespace-only name, each with a directory filled, show the name error on the name field, leave the path valid, and send no storage create. Submitting an empty path and submitting a whitespace-only path, each with the name req-probe filled, show the path-required error on the path field, leave the name valid, and send no storage create.
checklist_items.1.5: The local and NFS options are selected and their conditional fields appear; shared_dir and nfs_cache are MISSING
checklist_items.1.6: Switching type changes the path label and reveals the NFS export
checklist_items.1.7: Minimum local creation reaches the exact POST body
checklist_items.1.8: The minimum create leaves the scope at all nodes. That POST carries all nodes true and an empty target list, and the independent GET stores all nodes with no label. A second create sets the scope to labels and fills the label team=alpha, with its own directory. That save returns 201. The independent GET stores type local, that directory, all nodes false, and the label team=alpha. The detail page shows that directory, the chosen-scope sentence, and team=alpha. The label row in that create dialog is one start-aligned space.
checklist_items.1.9: covered: While the create POST is held a forced second click and Enter send no further create, and the later 201 is the only stored storage
checklist_items.1.10: PARTIAL: the server's refusal of an out-of-root path keeps the dialog and draft, writes nothing and shows the save-failed alert; BLOCKED_PRODUCT: the reason is not actionable for this refusal and same-dialog retry (see missing)
checklist_items.1.14: Refresh and independent GET preserve the record
checklist_items.1.12: Changing only the name keeps the directory and the all-nodes scope. That save returns 200 and the independent GET keeps the new name, the same directory, type local, and all nodes. The edit dialog has no switch. Saving the label team=alpha keeps the name and the directory, returns 200, and the independent GET has all_nodes false and that label. Changing that label from team=alpha to zone=east keeps the name and the directory. Clearing the label value keeps the key zone. Removing the label returns the storage to all nodes. Each of those saves returns 200, and each independent GET matches, with the directory unchanged. Restoring the name keeps the directory and all nodes. The detail capacity card's show-nodes control is one link button.
checklist_items.1.13: While the edit dialog is open on the label team=alpha, another session's PATCH returns 200 and advances the revision. The independent GET stays all nodes, the same directory, and no label. Saving that draft returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED. The dialog stays open on team and alpha. The conflict alert shows the reload-and-try-again sentence and one alert icon. Cancel closes the dialog and sends no further save. Reloading the detail page and opening edit shows all nodes and no label field. Saving the label team=alpha again returns 200 with that reloaded revision, and the independent GET stores that label. Restoring all nodes returns 200, and the independent GET is all nodes with the same directory and no label.
checklist_items.5.5: Switching local↔NFS reveals/hides the conditional fields and switching back leaves no stale NFS field
checklist_items.12.7: Delete names the storage and requires confirmation
checklist_items.12.1: covered: Add storage on the storage page opens the dialog named by the add title
checklist_items.12.2: covered: Add dialog at 1440x900: the dialog and footer Save stay inside the viewport, and the title, body and footer sit inside the dialog without overlap
checklist_items.12.3: covered: Default focus is inside the add dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: covered: Cancel, Escape, close and mask each return focus to the Add storage button and send no POST
checklist_items.12.5: N/A: the local add dialog has no nested child layer
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the create POST is held the footer Save is disabled and a forced second click sends no further create request; the 502 keeps the name and path and shows the server reason; the later 201 matches the independent detail GET and the refreshed list row
checklist_items.12.8: The edit dialog sends the previewed expected_updated_at. After another writer advances the revision, Save returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED, the label draft stays in the open dialog, and the independent GET keeps all nodes, the original path and the other writer's revision. Teardown is not the assertion
checklist_items.2.7: Text carrying HTML is displayed as text. The name has a lowercase alphabet, so the path is the field that can carry markup: a second storage is created through the real form, its stored path is moved to a value embedding through the real PATCH route, and the independent GET confirms the server holds it. The detail view then shows the raw string as a text node - the carrying element has no child elements - and neither the detail view nor the list row gains an img or script element. The case cleans up its own storage. No product mutation was performed for this item: the assertion is a direct DOM-structure check, not a behavioural discriminator.
